updated_for: Top-ten operating hydropower reference layer and Kali Gandaki A naming correction
research_boundary: Only source-backed geography and source-backed project reference points are shown. Project points are not treated as full project footprints. Screening candidates, hazard areas, infrastructure-proximity layers and environmental constraints remain absent until governed evidence or reproducible analysis outputs are admitted.
ranking_method: Ten major operating hydropower projects verified for this map and ordered by installed/nameplate capacity. This is not a ranking of annual energy, present output, economics, reliability, environmental performance or research importance.
ranking_date_context: The Department of Electricity Development operating-project register consulted for this release was current in September 2026; recent commercial-operation status was cross-checked from project/operator and Global Energy Monitor records where needed.
coordinate_rule: Every hydropower marker is a published project/plant reference coordinate. The marker meaning and precision are recorded per project. A marker must not be interpreted as the project's complete headworks, waterways, reservoir, powerhouse, transmission or environmental footprint.
kali_gandaki_correction: Kali Gandaki is the river/geographic name. Kali Gandaki A is a hydropower project/station. The highlighted map coordinate 27.931, 83.6152 is the powerhouse/generating-station point near Beltari/Yamgha, Syangja; the dam/headworks are upstream near Mirmi.
